title: fix: expose renderVictoryPanel as global and guard against orphaned build state
body:
## Summary
- `window.renderVictoryPanel` was missing from the global exports in `main.js`, causing the Cancel/Establish trade route buttons inside the Victory panel to throw `ReferenceError: renderVictoryPanel is not defined` after executing their action — the panel would not refresh and appear broken
- `renderBuildPanel` would throw a `TypeError` when `game.currentBuild` or `game.currentUnitBuild` contained an ID that no longer exists in `BUILDINGS`/`UNIT_TYPES` (e.g. after a game mod is removed), silently leaving the Build panel empty and non-functional

## Test plan
- [ ] Open Victory panel (V), establish or cancel a trade route — panel should refresh correctly
- [ ] Verify Build panel (B) opens with content as expected during normal gameplay
- [ ] All 188 tests pass (`npm test`)

Fixes #131
